articles.title: Alien megastructures or ultra-cold stars? New study maps how to spot a Dyson swarm
articles.summary: A University of Arkansas study reveals that Dyson swarms—hypothetical alien megastructures—would make stars appear impossibly cold, shifting them to an empty region of the H-R diagram. The James Webb telescope could spot these anomalies among red dwarfs.

articles.title: SpaceX test-fires 33-engine Super Heavy booster, paving way for Starship Flight 13
articles.summary: SpaceX completed a 25-second static fire of Booster 20, the latest Super Heavy, at Starbase Texas. The successful test keeps Starship on track for a July 15 launch, aiming to resolve issues from Flight 12 and advance reusability.

articles.title: Mount Etna's secret origin: could it be a rare 'petit-spot' volcano?
articles.summary: A University of Lausanne study proposes that Mount Etna formed via a mechanism similar to petit-spot volcanoes—tiny magma pockets squeezed up by tectonic plate collision. This would make Etna the first giant of its kind, challenging traditional volcano classification.
